title: Zhuangzi, Outer 14 (Tianzifang): 真 is unadorned, and 目击而道存
desc: 真 is not sincerity but the unadorned state, set opposite 迹. 目擊而道存 crosses in four characters with nothing said; 唐肆 is a market that closed.

title: Zhuangzi, Outer 15 (Zhibeiyou): every character in this chapter is an argument
desc: 知 travels north into the dark and gets further away. Three questions answered with three 無; 為道者日損; 通天下一氣耳 is the same batch of material changing form, not sameness.

title: Zhuangzi, Misc 1 (Gengsangchu): 日计之而不足, 岁计之而有余
desc: 偏得 puts a ceiling on him before the story starts. 畫然知者 and 挈然仁者 are kept away; 擁腫 and 鞅掌 stay. By the day it is not enough — both halves are true.

title: Zhuangzi, Misc 2 (Xuwugui): 劳 points in two directions
desc: The Marquis says 'you are worn out'; 徐無鬼 says the tired one is you. 盈 and 黜 — add and subtract are both illness. Four standards met is 國馬, and second grade.

title: Zhuangzi, Misc 3 (Zeyang): 相助以德, 相助消也
desc: Not helping each other with virtue but helping each other wear away. 飲人以和 gives something drinkable; 人與之鑑 — the mirror was handed over, and the comparison came with it.

title: Zhuangzi, Misc 4 (Waiwu): 必 is the only thing on trial
desc: Five names, three loyal and two vicious, one outcome. 忠未必信; blood kept three years turns to jade; 焚和 is the heaviest charge; 月固不勝火 refuses to console.

title: Zhuangzi, Misc 5 (Yuyan): 卮言 is not slippery speech
desc: 卮 is a cup: empty it stands, full it tips — no fixed posture, therefore able to fit. 重言 is not 'quote the old'; 陳人 is what age without warp and weft becomes.

title: Zhuangzi, Misc 6 (Tianxia): 方术 is a corner, 道术 is the whole
desc: 皆以其有為不可加矣 names the disease as closure, not error. 備 is 本數 plus 末度; 內聖外王 is this chapter's phrase, and it describes one affair, not two careers.
